thesis: CHA is in a confirmed uptrend, trading above its SMA20, SMA50 and SMA200 with strong 63-day relative strength, and it is pulling back on light volume after a special-dividend and three-year dividend-policy catalyst. The balance sheet is strong (cash far above debt, positive free cash flow) and forward P/E is low in absolute terms. The analyst mean target is above the last price, and short interest is low. The setup is weak, though. Reward/risk to the 52-week high is only about 1.1. Earnings fall inside the holding window. The special-dividend ex-date is unknown and could mechanically hit the stop. The regime is risk-off. This supports at most a small, conditional position, not a conviction long.
